ZERO FIELDS, ZERO VALUE SETS, ZERO TABLES IS THE CORRECT AND DELIBERATE ANSWER FOR THIS PAGE UNDER LENS B. The Budget Configuration page (/expense/admin/invoice/budgetConfiguration.asp) has NO documentary basis in this corpus, and its configuration surface is documented in an EXTERNAL guide the corpus names but does not contain: the *Shared: Budget Setup Guide*. This corpus is Concur Invoice Professional Edition only (deliverable_ids 41460672 admin-guides and 41460673 tools-guides); Shared deliverables are out of scope of the 2026-08-29 crawl. I did not invent a plausible budget-configuration screen and I did not re-home Budget references that belong to other pages.

EXHAUSTIVE SEARCH PERFORMED (all four directories, both guide dirs weighted equally per Rule 1): the literal strings 'Budget Configuration', 'budgetConfiguration', 'budgetConfiguration.asp', 'Budget Admin', 'Budget Item', 'Budget Manager', 'Budget Viewer', 'Budget Owner', 'Budget Category', 'Manage Budget', 'Budget Tracking', 'Budget Adjustment', 'Budget Period' and 'budget item' each return ZERO files corpus-wide, case-insensitively. Case-insensitive 'budget' returns exactly 22 files: 16 in admin-guides, 6 in tools-guides, and ZERO in either release-note directory (so there is not even a release note to date or corroborate a UI variant). Exactly one file carries 'budget' in its name: budget-approval-59251c3b.md (27 lines total). The apparent 'Budget Owner' hit resolves to the prose phrase 'budget ownership' in benefits-of-using-cost-object-approval-ed5de5de.md, not a role or a field.

LENS B MECHANICAL SWEEP (mandatory, and run in full): for every one of the 22 budget-mentioning files I ran grep -c '<table' and grep -c '^ *|' and wc -l. RAW <table> COUNT IS ZERO IN ALL 22 FILES, so fromRawHtmlTable is correctly false everywhere and there is no raw-HTML catalog to lose here (Rule 3 satisfied, not merely assumed). Pipe-table counts are non-zero in six files, and I read every one of those tables in full rather than sampling them (Rule 2): add-a-custom-audit-rule-0f1d320e.md (19) and add-a-custom-audit-rule-43e3f9aa.md (19) are the SAME content republished in gerund/imperative pairs, and their tables are audit-rule creation fields; audit-rules-8b297db8.md (124) is the Audit Rules settings surface; conditional-expressions-and-the-condition-page-4d98af34.md (38) and the-condition-page-5d4ea870.md (71) are Audit Rules condition-page operand tables; general-information-8b3b0308.md (139) and purchase-request-and-purchase-order-8b36ae07.md (130) are general-information and PR/PO tables whose only 'budget' hits are revision-history lines. NONE of these tables belongs to Budget Configuration. All of them belong to pages already in the graph (Audit Rules) or to pages not yet built (the PO Matching group). ZERO long catalogs (no single list exceeding ~15 items) relate to this page. No illustrative table was skipped for this page, because no table on any candidate file is about this page at all.

THE EXTERNAL DEFERRAL, VERBATIM AND grep -F VERIFIED. budget-approval-59251c3b.md contains no procedure, no field table, no navigation path, and closes with: 'For more information about budget approval and budget workflows, refer to the _Shared: Budget Setup Guide_.' It also establishes the feature exists without describing its configuration: 'Clients who use the Budget feature can set up budget approval for both invoices and purchase requests.' The SAME outward deferral repeats in approver-terminology-8559861c.md and in BOTH copies of add-a-custom-audit-rule-*.md ('For audit rule notifications for Budget, refer to the Shared: Budget Setup Guide.'). Four independent files point at one guide that is not here. That convergence is itself the finding: THE CONFIGURATION SURFACE OF THIS PAGE IS DOCUMENTED, JUST NOT IN THIS CORPUS.

PROVISIONING FACT worth carrying forward for the automation: vat-at-the-line-item-level-itemization-summary-only-a41e7ad6.md states 'The Budget feature is a purchased service.' A tenant without the purchase will not surface this page at all, which is consistent with the corpus never documenting its controls.

BUDGET REFERENCES DELIBERATELY NOT HARVESTED HERE (page ownership, the failure mode grep cannot catch). (a) the-condition-page-5d4ea870.md defines a Budget audit-rule DATA OBJECT ('Budget: Budgets associated with an invoice or purchase request') whose operands are Budget Amount, Budget Name, Budget Remaining Amount, Budget Type and HasBudget. Those are Audit Rules condition operands on page.audit-rules, which is ALREADY BUILT with coverage good; emitting them here would duplicate and mis-home them. (b) events-triggers-72339a13.md documents the workflow event 'Payment Request Budget Submit: The rule is triggered when an invoice or purchase request is associated with a submitted budget.' That belongs to Workflows, which is NOT YET BUILT. (c) workflow-667cee21.md frames budget approval as a Workflow capability ('supporting features such as budget approval, vendor consolidation, and self-approval') - again Workflows, not this page. (d) approver-terminology-8559861c.md defines the role 'Budget Approver: Budget approvers approves invoice and purchase request transactions.' (SAP's subject-verb error is verbatim.) That is an approver-role definition, not a control on this page. (e) define-the-who-in-a-transaction-1488d041.md uses 'Budget Center' only as an EXAMPLE accounting segment name, on Accounting Administration, already built. (f) The six allocation files and distribute-allocate-a-purchase-request-689dbc62.md are Allocations end-user prose. (g) benefits-of-using-cost-object-approval-ed5de5de.md is Cost Object Approval prose.

I emitted ZERO dependencyCandidates on purpose. Every dependency record requires a real sourceField on THIS page, and this page has none; a dependency anchored to an empty sourceField would be an unwired artefact of exactly the kind Rule 7 warns about. The genuine cross-page relationships are recorded in prose above so the graph owner can wire them from the OTHER side (Audit Rules -> Budget data object; Workflows -> Payment Request Budget Submit) once Workflows is built.

No mustRead files were specified for this page and I did not manufacture a reading list; mustReadSkipped is empty because the must-read list was empty. No sourceQuotes were emitted, so the post-write five-quote re-verification had nothing to sample - however I ran grep -F -c against the cited file for all eight verbatim strings quoted in these notes and every one returned exactly 1. RECOMMENDATION TO THE MERGE PASS: either omit this page node entirely, or keep it as an explicit zero-field 'documented elsewhere' marker naming the Shared: Budget Setup Guide, so a future config writer learns immediately where to look instead of concluding the page is undocumented.
